description: Paseo CLI - create, drive and monitor AI coding agents from the command line, backed by a local daemon. Installs the npm package '@getpaseo/cli'; the command is 'paseo'.
notes: State (agents, config, models, daemon.log) lives in scoop\persist\paseo\home instead of the default %USERPROFILE%\.paseo - this manifest points PASEO_HOME there. Scoop preserves it across update and uninstall, so your agents survive both.

Migrating an existing install: stop the daemon, move %USERPROFILE%\.paseo into scoop\persist\paseo\home, then start it again. Otherwise paseo starts empty and the old directory is left behind (the bundled voice models alone are ~1 GB).
The daemon is separate from the CLI: 'paseo daemon start' / 'stop' / 'status'. 'paseo onboard' does first-time setup and prints pairing instructions.
Stop the daemon before 'scoop update paseo' or 'scoop cleanup' - a running daemon holds node.exe inside the app directory and scoop cannot replace or remove it.

Large install (~500 MB): the dependency tree bundles the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs plus native modules (node-pty, sherpa-onnx). Those native modules are built against a Node ABI, so reinstall after the runtime moves to a new Node major.
pre_install: # node-pty's install script shells out to bare 'node'; this bucket keeps Node.js off PATH, so put it there for this process only
# npm also runs the package's own 'prepare' script, which can fail on a devDependency we deliberately skipped - what matters is that the dependencies landed
